description: The old coal cellar, whitewashed, with the junction cabinet and the incinerator flue coming through one corner and going up. There is a shelf down here with a row of small boxes on it, each one labelled with a name and a date, waiting for somebody to decide whether they are coming back for it. Some of the dates are very old. She does not throw them out.
name: Paws for Thought — The Waiting Room — Utility Room
